expectations.text: Uses git-stack navigation (git-stack previous) to reach the earlier commit instead of copying SHAs
expectations.evidence: Alternative section: 'git-stack previous --branch --stash' to move down to feature-a; references commits by branch name, no SHA copying.

expectations.text: Uses `git-stack amend` (optionally with -a) to meld the staged fix into the target commit
expectations.evidence: 'git add user.rs' then 'git-stack amend # meld the fix into feature-a'.

expectations.text: Notes that git-stack automatically rebases the descendant commits onto the amended commit
expectations.evidence: 'automatically rebases 567271d, feature-b, and feature-c onto the rewritten commit'; 'descendants are rebased automatically'.

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend `git rebase -i` / interactive rebase or `git commit --amend` + manual rebase as the primary method
expectations.evidence: Primary is fixup workflow / git-stack amend; explicitly argues against plain 'git rebase -i'.

summary: All four assertions satisfied: navigation via git-stack previous, git-stack amend/fixup, auto-restack of descendants, and explicitly avoids interactive rebase.
